identifiers.name: CBS municipality code (gemeentecode)
identifiers.description: The 4-digit code of a Dutch municipality given by Statistics Netherlands (CBS), written without the GM prefix of its statistical tables: the level at which a distribution operator's area, local planning rules and most datasets are decided. It changes when municipalities merge. It is not the postal code.

identifiers.name: BAG address (nummeraanduiding)
identifiers.description: The 16-digit identifier of an address in the Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG): the code of the municipality that created it, the object type 20, and a 10-digit serial number. The first four digits keep the municipality of creation after a merger.

identifiers.name: BAG building (pand)
identifiers.description: The 16-digit identifier of a building in the BAG: the code of the municipality that created it, the object type 10, and a 10-digit serial number. The 3DBAG keys its 3D models by the same identifier.

identifiers.name: KvK number
identifiers.description: The 8-digit number of an enterprise or a legal person in the Dutch Business Register (Handelsregister) of the Chamber of Commerce (Kamer van Koophandel).
